subject: FinCo — incident update, root cause summary, and remediation commitments
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramirez <elena@finco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: FinCo — initial incident notification and short next steps

Elena,

First, I'm truly sorry for the disruption you experienced on 2026-12-13 between 22:35–23:10 UTC. I know this impacted your nightly batch scoring job and customer-facing inference calls — that's unacceptable.

Quick summary: we identified a control-plane cascading restart that temporarily prevented autoscaling from provisioning GPU capacity for a subset of dedicated pods in us-west-2. The customer-facing side remained up for ~65% of requests, but latency and failures increased for the remainder of traffic.

Immediate steps we took:
- Stabilized the control plane and restored normal autoscaling within 30 minutes.
- Failed requests were retried automatically; we are validating end-to-end replay coverage.
- Escalated to infra and runtime teams; assigned INF-4721 for a full RCA.

Attached is a short draft timeline we pulled together (incident_timeline_draft.pdf). We are preparing a concise root-cause summary and remediation commitments for you — expect that by EOD Wednesday PST.

If you'd like a 30-minute walkthrough, I'm available tomorrow morning. Again, apologies for the disruption and thank you for your patience.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: FinCo — draft RCA and remediation (internal)

Rachel — pulling together a concise RCA + commitments for FinCo. See notes below (internal draft); happy to refine wording before we send externally.

Root cause (one-paragraph draft):
A transient control-plane restart propagated an out-of-order scaling signal to dedicated serving pools in us-west-2. The orchestration retries coincided with a temporary quota exhaustion on our internal placement service, causing a subset of pods to remain unprovisioned for roughly 35 minutes. This led to increased latency and 5xx errors for affected calls until autoscaling stabilized.

Contributing factors:
- A recent change to control-plane restart backoff logic reduced visibility into restart cascades.
- Placement service had an edge-case race leading to perceived capacity exhaustion under a burst of concurrent scale requests.
- Our synthetic workload coverage did not include the specific concurrent scaling pattern exhibited by FinCo's nightly job.

Proposed remediation actions (owner — ETA):
1) Control-plane restart hardening: add coordinated restart fencing; owner: Marcus Lin; ETA: 2027-01-14
2) Placement service fix (race condition): owner: Hannah Schmitt; ETA: 2027-01-21
3) Better synthetic coverage for concurrent scale patterns (test harness update + regression): owner: Lauren Bishop; ETA: 2027-01-28
4) Short-term operational mitigation: increase conservative placement timeouts and add a monitoring alert for placement saturation; owner: On-call infra; ETA: 72 hours (applied)
5) Customer protection: automatic request-level retry window increase for dedicated pools to reduce user-visible failures; owner: Runtime team; ETA: 2027-01-11

Attachments included for your review: INF-4721_rca_notes.txt (internal logs and timeline) and remediation_commitments_table.csv (owner/ETA matrix).

Let me know any edits; once we align I'll hand to you for external communication and cc procurement/legal as requested.

—Marcus
Director, Platform Engineering
Marcus Lin

Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: FinCo — final impact summary, RCA (concise), and remediation commitments

Elena / Sanjay / FinCo procurement team,

Thank you for your patience while we completed the internal investigation. Below is a concise customer-friendly RCA, a concise timeline, and the concrete remediation commitments with owners and ETAs. I've attached the internal notes and a commitments table for your records. Happy to walk through this in a 30-minute call — please pick a slot here: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij

1) Customer-facing RCA (one paragraph)
A transient control-plane restart caused a cascade of concurrent scale requests to our placement service in us-west-2. An edge-case race in the placement service combined with a temporary visibility gap in restart handling prevented timely provisioning of a portion of your dedicated serving capacity. As a result, some requests experienced increased latency and elevated error rates for a ~35-minute window on 2026-12-13. We have stabilized the service and implemented immediate mitigations.

2) Short timeline (high level)
- 2026-12-13 22:35 UTC: control-plane restart detected
- 22:38–23:10 UTC: autoscaling and placement retries failed for subset of dedicated pods; customer impact window
- 23:05 UTC: emergency remediation applied (conservative timeouts and restart fencing)
- 23:40 UTC: autoscaling returned to baseline; monitoring shows request success rate normalized

3) Remediation commitments (owner — ETA)
- Control-plane restart fencing and improved backoff/visibility — Marcus Lin — 2027-01-14
- Placement service race fix and added checks for concurrent scale — Hannah Schmitt — 2027-01-21
- Expanded synthetic tests to cover concurrent-scaling patterns used by FinCo — Lauren Bishop — 2027-01-28
- Request-level retry window increase for dedicated pools (reduces user-visible failures) — Runtime team — 2027-01-11
- Operational alerting for placement saturation (already applied) — On-call infra — Applied (within 72 hours)

4) SLA / credits
We are reviewing the impact against your contract (section 3.2). Preliminary assessment indicates this incident meets the threshold for a one-time service credit. Procurement: please expect a formal credit proposal by next business day; Rachel will coordinate the paperwork.

5) Next steps
- We will schedule a 30-minute technical review to walk through the technical appendix and answer your team’s questions (link above).
- We'll provide weekly status updates on remediation progress until all items are complete.

Attachments: INF-4721_rca_notes.txt (internal logs and timeline), remediation_commitments_table.csv (owner / ETA)

Again, sincere apologies for the disruption. We value FinCo’s partnership and are committed to earning back your trust.

Best regards,
Rachel Kim
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
